newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia net foreign reserves down to $9.88 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia net foreign reserves down to $9.88 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves dropped back $11.6 million and stood at $9.88 billion as of Jan 10, the last date for which figures are available, the central bank said in a report issued Monday.

The fall from a historic high of $9.896 billion at Dec 30 was attributed to a slowdown in the flood of dollars into Colombia's money markets in December, which forced the central bank to intervene heavily to prop up the greenback.
The fall in net foreign reserves is the first since Sept. 7, according to central bank figures.
